# IRTnorm
The goal of IRTnorm is to enable norm score derivations based on Bayesian IRT-based 
continuous norming models. 
It covers model selection and fitting, as well as evaluating the fit and norming
newly observed individuals. 


## Installation
You can install the development version of IRTnorm from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("HannahHeister/IRTnorm")
```

Fitting the models in this package requires [CmdStan](https://mc-stan.org/users/interfaces/cmdstan) and the [cmdstanr](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/) R package. cmdstanr is not on CRAN, so install it from the Stan repository and then use it to install CmdStan:
```r
install.packages(
  "cmdstanr",
  repos = c("https://stan-dev.r-universe.dev", getOption("repos"))
)
cmdstanr::install_cmdstan()
```

You will also need a working C++ toolchain.
See the [cmdstanr getting started guide](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/articles/cmdstanr.html) for platform-specific setup instructions.
